claim_scope: A same-host, same-resource diagnostic of Route 1 single-point energy+force solvent overhead and a named GAFF2/OBC-II MM comparison. Every result is indexed by gas MLIP, molecule-size bin, device, OpenMM platform, and warm versus in-process construction-cold policy. It is not a universal faster-than-MM, negligible-overhead, or production-throughput claim.
limitations: Three label-free development structures are performance representatives, not an accuracy set.
The large-bin case was selected only after a label-blind topology-determinism screen; the screen is an engineering fairness gate, not scientific validation.
Construction-cold is an in-process calculator/context cold start and is not Python-process or filesystem-cache cold.

The named MM comparison changes the gas potential and measures runtime only; its Route 1 and MM calls are interleaved within a dedicated paired block, but it is not an energy or accuracy parity comparison.
Host-load isolation is checked at entry, immediately before timing, and immediately after timing; these endpoint snapshots do not prove continuous whole-run isolation.
No timing ratio may be generalized beyond the exact recorded model, molecule, device, OpenMM platform, and warm/cold definition.
The protocol does not predeclare that Route 1 will be faster than the named MM comparator.
